blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution panel in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial said its decision to repeatedly drop witnesses is not a bluff or an attempt to confuse the defense, but part of its continuing assessment of evidence presented to the court. Lead public prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said in a press briefing Thursday, Day 32 of the trial, that the panel regularly reviews its list of witnesses and checking if their testimonies would provide new information or merely repeat evidence. Luistro made the statement after the prosecution withdrew former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV as a witness for Article […]...
